items.reason: The early return for a matching date override bypasses busy-period checks, allowing slots that overlap existing bookings or calendar events.
Comparing separately constructed Dayjs objects with === prevents zero-length, day-off overrides from being detected.
The working-hours end bound uses slotStartTime instead of slotEndTime, allowing events to extend beyond working hours.
Timezone conversion discards the shifted date, causing midnight-crossing overrides to become invalid ranges or apply to the wrong invitee day.
The override upper bound checks the slot start instead of its end, accepting events that extend past the override window. The additional lower-bound correction does not change this match.
